body.p: Nova Lake HX platform supports DDR5 and LPDDR5x memory technology. This chapter covers the guidelines to design a Nova Lake HX platform with the following Plan of Record (POR) supported system memory interface configurations and features.
body.note: For complete Nova Lake HX processor system memory interface POR feature support details refer the latest release of the Nova Lake Mobile Processor External Design Specification, Volume 1 of 2 (# 844316).
